question: Which among the following dance forms of India is associated with Rajasthan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kalbelia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kalbelia**

 
 
• Kalbelia or kalbeliya dance form is associated with a Rajasthani tribe of the same name.
 
• Kalbeliya dance was included in UNESCO’s list of the Cultural Heritage of Humanity in 2010.
 
• It is performed by the women of the Kalbeliya community.
 
• Kalbeliya dancer's clothes are flowing black skirts mixed in red and black hues and embroidered in unique patterns.
 
• Kalbeliya dance has traditional musical instruments known as Poongi.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Dance Form
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Odissi
 Originated from the Eastern Indian state of Odisha, Odissi is one of the oldest classical dance forms in India. It is characterized by its graceful and expressional performance. The dance is a blend of Nritta (pure dance), Nritya (dance with emotions) and Natya (dramatic representation). Odissi is typically accompanied by musicians, where the dancer's motions express the song's narrative and emotions.
 
 

 Bharatanatyam
 Bharatanatyam is a classical Indian dance form originating from Tamil Nadu. This dance form is known for its grace, elegance, purity, tenderness, expression and sculpturesque poses. Bharatanatyam generally follows the theoretical framework outlined in the Natya Shastra, an ancient text for theater and performance arts. The dance is highly symbolic and includes gestures (mudras) that communicate stories from Indian mythology and spiritual ideas.
 
 

 Kathakali
 Kathakali is a major form of classical Indian dance originating in the Indian state of Kerala. It is a performance art that combines dancing, acting, vocal music, percussion, costumes and make-up. Kathakali's stories are taken from the Indian epics and Puranas, and the performance is characterized by its dramatic and elaborate costumes and makeup, as well as the detailed gestures, expressions and dance movements.
